:::

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Strong induction](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/induction.html#def-strong-induction) ($b, c, k, n \in \bbZ$) | $(P(b) \land \cdots \land P(c) \land (\forall k \ge c, ((P(b) \land \cdots \land P(k)) \Rightarrow P(k + 1)))) \Rightarrow (\forall n \ge b, P(n))$ |
